# Shania Khan

> Official website of Shania Khan, Vogue France-featured author, Soft60 founder, creator, and brand strategist. Shania's work centers on wealth, beauty, nervous system regulation, soft power, and building a calmer, richer life with less chaos.

## About Shania Khan

Shania Khan is the author of Rich Grandma Energy and The Goodbye Theory and the founder of Soft60. Her work connects nervous system regulation, wealth identity, soft power, personal style, modern luxury, and more than 20 years of experience in luxury, beauty, and brand. Her recurring ideas include Money Is a Frequency, Beauty Is a Frequency, Luxury Is Nervous System Regulation, Chaos Repels Wealth, Room Service Theory, and the Death of the Girl Boss.

## Books

- Rich Grandma Energy by Shania Khan: A book about standards, identity, money, softness, and building a life that feels as good as it looks.
- The Goodbye Theory by Shania Khan: Nineteen theories on endings, identity, timing, and the lives that become available when expired versions of the self are released.

## Core concepts

- **Rich Grandma Energy**: Shania Khan's framework for standards, wealth, identity, softness, taste, and building a life that feels as good as it looks.
- **Soft60**: Shania Khan's community and 60-day practice for creating more calm, capacity, clarity, and consistency in real life.
- **Money Is a Frequency / Wealth Is a Frequency**: Shania Khan's work on money, receiving, standards, wealth identity, and the ways chaos can interfere with financial capacity.
- **Beauty Is a Frequency**: Shania Khan's work on beauty as ritual, self-concept, standards, and the way a woman inhabits her life before changing her appearance.
- **Luxury Is Nervous System Regulation**: Shania Khan's idea that real luxury includes time, space, calm, capacity, and a life that does not require constant urgency.
- **Chaos Repels Wealth**: Shania Khan's idea that chronic disorder, urgency, and overstimulation can make it harder to hold the habits, decisions, and capacity that support wealth.
- **Soft Power**: Shania Khan's framework for influence, standards, self-possession, and building without constant force.
- **Room Service Theory**: A Shania Khan concept about the value of designing a life with enough support, ease, and infrastructure that everything does not require personal effort.


## Nervous system reset

- [Nervous System Reset](https://shaniakhan.com/nervous-system-reset/): Shania Khan's practical explanation of a nervous system reset for women, including the six-part Soft60 Method: regulate daily, subtract chaos, gentle movement, eat with presence, soft identity proof, and daily reflection. The page distinguishes this self-guided wellness framework from medical treatment and links to the 93-page Soft60 Guide.

## Cornerstone essays

- [Chaos Repels Wealth: What I Actually Mean](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/chaos-repels-wealth/): Shania Khan's explanation of how chronic urgency, disorder, scattered attention, and reactive decision-making can interfere with wealth-building and the ability to hold more money.
- [Beauty Is a Frequency: Before the Mirror Changes](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/beauty-is-a-frequency/): Shania Khan's explanation of beauty as ritual, self-concept, standards, and the way a woman inhabits her life before anything changes in the mirror.
- [Luxury Is Not a Price Point. It Is a Nervous System State.](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/luxury-nervous-system/): Shania Khan's framework connecting luxury with time, space, calm, capacity, and nervous system regulation.
- [Nervous System Regulation and Money](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/nervous-system-and-money/): Shania Khan's writing on pricing, receiving, money decisions, and nervous system patterns.
- [Your Wealth Identity Is the Problem, Not Your Strategy](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/wealth-identity/): Shania Khan's writing on wealth identity and the internal capacity to hold more.
- [What Is Soft Power?](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/what-is-soft-power/): Shania Khan's definition of soft power as influence, standards, self-possession, and ambition without constant force.


## Digital products

- [Wealth Is a Frequency product](https://shaniakhan.com/shop/wealth-is-a-frequency/): Shania Khan's digital wealth planner focused on receiving, standards, wealth identity, money language, and reducing money chaos.
- [Beauty Is a Frequency product](https://shaniakhan.com/shop/beauty-is-a-frequency/): Shania Khan's digital beauty planner focused on self-concept, mirror work, ritual, and beauty as self-respect.
- [Health Is a Frequency product](https://shaniakhan.com/shop/health-is-a-frequency/): Shania Khan's digital health planner focused on body trust, restorative routines, healing language, and wellbeing without performance.

- [Soft60 Guide product](https://shaniakhan.com/shop/soft60-guide/): Shania Khan's 93-page, 60-day digital Soft60 Method guide with the 6 Laws of Soft60, daily and weekly reflection pages, ritual examples, tracking, Soft Space pages, and completion integration.
